baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَذَّبَ ... مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ... كَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
baseline_models.mechanism: كَذَّبَ assigns the message to falsehood, مِن قَبْلِهِمْ supplies completed predecessors, and كَانَ places نَكِيرِ in realized time. فَكَيْفَ therefore asks about the manner of an enacted repudiation, not merely whether one occurred.

activation_trace.role: Attributing a thing or its bearer to falsehood supplies the deniers' active verdict and initiates the answerable offense.
Temporal precedence places completed communities ahead of the addressees as empirical precedents.
Occurrence and presence in time make the repudiation a realized event rather than a bare possibility.
A censured ugliness that is checked supplies both evaluative rejection and restraining force to نَكِيرِ.

changed_reading.before: Earlier peoples denied and were punished.
changed_reading.after: Their false verdict was answered by a historically realized act that exposed the wrong as objectionable and checked it; the verse demands attention to how that answer operated.

baseline_models.mechanism: The two roots stage opposed acts of judgment: takdhib labels as false, while nakir ranges over nonrecognition or repudiation and alteration into an unfamiliar, unwelcome condition. The answer fits the offense structurally: a false classification returns as decisive repudiation and lost recognizability.

activation_trace.role: Attribution to falsehood makes denial an imposed classification rather than passive ignorance.
Nonrecognition opposed to acknowledgment makes the response a reversal in the economy of recognition.
Change into an unknown or disliked condition gives the reversal a concrete experiential result.

changed_reading.before: نَكِيرِ is an undifferentiated punishment after disbelief.
changed_reading.after: نَكِيرِ is a matched recognition reversal: those who falsely classify the warning meet repudiation and a condition no longer recognizable as secure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening turns perception into a test: inspect, return sight, repeat, and receive sight back rebuffed and depleted. Attached to فَكَيْفَ ... نَكِيرِ, this converts the question from bare intensification into an invitation to test the historical outcome until the observer's contrary expectation fails.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence furnishes prior cases as the object of the later inspection.
The severe, strange affair is what the rhetorical inspection asks the hearer to assess.
A test that makes the true condition appear supplies the surah's initial evidentiary posture.
Repeated seeing by eye or insight makes examination, rather than hearsay, the operative method.
Returning to what was examined supplies iteration until the attempted objection is answered.
Sight returning rebuffed and dulled supplies the reversal of the observer's challenging stance.
Exhausted, cut-off force supplies the endpoint of repeated resistant inspection.

structural_cues: 67:3 commands a first return of sight; 67:4 repeats the return and states the observer's resulting condition before 67:18 asks كَيْفَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, repeated visual return, and a rebuffed, exhausted observer; I infer that the later كَيْفَ reuses this inspection posture for history. A live alternative is simple rhetorical amazement at severity.

changed_reading.before: كَيْفَ merely heightens the severity of the punishment.
changed_reading.after: كَيْفَ also invites an evidence test: look back at prior outcomes as repeatedly as needed, and the objection returns defeated rather than the precedent yielding a defect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence warning, denial, counterfactual hearing or restraint, and confession supplies a complete recognition process. The generic historical statement in 67:18 now reads as a repeatable transition from rejecting a warning's truth to being made to acknowledge the fault under its consequence.

activation_trace.role: The contrast between nonrecognition and acknowledgment lets نَكِيرِ close an epistemic reversal.
A warning that frightens in order to awaken caution supplies the rejected opportunity before consequence.
The speakers' attribution of the warner to falsehood concretely instantiates the focus ayah's denial.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies the missing receptive act, not merely missing sound.
Intellect as a restraint against ignorance supplies the unused brake on denial.
Confession as acknowledgment or submission supplies the eventual recognition produced by the failed refusal.

structural_cues: 67:8-11 presents direct speech in the order warning received, warning denied, failed faculties named, then guilt confessed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered speech acts and confession; I infer that نَكِيرِ is the forcing condition that closes denial in acknowledgment. A live alternative keeps confession and punitive repudiation as adjacent but separate results.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports inherited unbelief followed by an external penalty.
changed_reading.after: The verse compresses a reproducible process: caution is offered, truth is falsely classified, receptive faculties are bypassed, and repudiation ends in unavoidable self-recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Manageable ground is immediately redescribed as capable of sinking and oscillation, while a stone-bearing wind supplies a second reversal of ordinary shelter. The near-parallel كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ then كَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ makes past repudiation the realized precedent for threatened loss of habitability.

activation_trace.role: Alteration from a liked or known condition to an unknown or disliked one supplies the governing reversal.
Making difficult terrain tractable supplies the familiar, enabled baseline that can be withdrawn.
Earth sinking into depth reverses its prior role as a manageable support.
Oscillation and repeated surging turn apparently stable ground into disorienting motion.
A stone-bearing wind supplies an atmospheric counterpart to the reversal from support to threat.
Warning that awakens caution labels these threatened reversals immediately before the focus ayah names realized repudiation.

structural_cues: 67:17 ends with فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ; 67:18 answers with predecessors and repeats فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tractability, threatened terrestrial and atmospheric reversals, and the paired كَيْفَ clauses; I infer that these threats exemplify how نَكِيرِ can operate. A live alternative treats the parallel only as warning, leaving past mechanisms unspecified.

changed_reading.before: Past peoples received a severe but unspecified punishment.
changed_reading.after: Past repudiation becomes precedent for a precise kind of shock: granted habitability can reverse, making familiar support move, engulf, or attack.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence challenges the promised time and the speaker's truth, then converts that speech dispute into a seen event drawing near and registering on faces. The focus ayah's prior realized كَانَ thus functions as temporal evidence: what current deniers hold at verbal distance has already crossed from claim to event before them.

activation_trace.role: Temporal priority lets predecessors answer a present challenge about whether and when the threatened event arrives.
Realized occurrence in time supplies the completed counterpart to a disputed future.
The severe, unfamiliar affair names what crosses from contested report into experienced event.
A promise bounded by an appointed time or place supplies the object of the deniers' timing challenge.
Truth as fulfillment in action makes actual arrival, rather than argument, the answer to the challenge.
Direct sight moves the disputed object from reported speech into perception.
An impulsion into nearness collapses the protective temporal distance presumed by the challenge.
What causes distress supplies the affective impact of the now-near event.
The face as visible front makes inward failed denial publicly legible when the event arrives.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from a spoken timing and truth challenge in 67:25 to sight, nearness, and bodily facial effect in 67:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the timing challenge, fulfillment branch, sight, nearness, and distressed faces; I infer that prior realized نَكِيرِ is offered as the same speech-to-event transition. A live alternative limits 67:18 to past peoples and treats 67:25-27 as a separate future scene.

changed_reading.before: The past-tense verse is only a backward historical notice.
changed_reading.after: The completed past becomes evidence about a disputed future: verbal distance collapses into seen nearness, and repudiation becomes publicly visible on those who challenged its truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a form-distant livestock image under ك ذ ب and reads punishment as subtraction rather than added force. It remains anchored in كَذَّبَ and the state-changing branch of نَكِيرِ, while the context repeatedly contrasts holding with withholding and accessible water with depth. Render it only as a possible material analogy, never as the lexical gloss of كَذَّبَ.

activation_trace.role: Milk expected to continue but then disappearing supplies a form-distant image of presumed continuity failing.
Change into an unknown or unwelcome condition turns failed continuity into experienced repudiation.
Holding and restraining supplies the normally continuous support by which the birds remain aloft.
The same holding image now functions as withholding, exposing dependence on continued provision.
Descent into depth supplies a final image of a sustaining resource becoming inaccessible.
A flowing spring supplies the accessible support whose possible absence sharpens the withdrawal model.

changed_reading.before: نَكِيرِ must be an externally added blow.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, repudiation may also be experienced as sustaining continuity ceasing: the hold loosens, provision is withheld, or accessible water retreats into depth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because charge and animal-motion branches are remote from the ordinary Form II sense in كَذَّبَ. It remains anchored in that focus verb and gains a visible kinetic mechanism from return, stubborn persistence, and recoil in the context. Render it as an exploratory motion analogy for denial's failed momentum, not as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: A charge proving true or false supplies a kinetic test of whether denial's advance can hold.
An animal running a stretch and then stopping to look behind supplies the abrupt failure of apparent momentum.
The severe strange event supplies the obstacle at which the confident advance breaks.
Returning after an attempt supplies the backward motion that tests and undoes confidence.
Stubborn persistence supplies denial's apparent forward continuity before its interruption.
Recoil and distancing supply the direction of denial's motion away from its object.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a static proposition held by earlier peoples.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial is a charge sustained by stubborn recoil: it seems to run forward, but نَكِيرِ is the severe encounter that stops it and forces a backward look.

strongest_changes: The immediate كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ / فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ pairing turns threatened reversal into historically verified precedent.
67:8-11 expands denial into a warning-to-confession process, so repudiation closes a failed recognition sequence rather than merely following it.
The repeated sight test in 67:2-4 makes كَيْفَ an invitation to inspect the outcome, not only an exclamation about severity.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots permit a compact reciprocity: false classification in كَذَّبَ meets repudiation and altered recognizability in نَكِيرِ. Context then gives that reciprocity material, epistemic, and temporal mechanisms without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: نَكِيرِ may foreground divine disapproval, punitive force, or the resulting unfamiliar condition; the packet keeps all three live.
The inspection echo from 67:3-4 is structurally strong but may remain rhetorical rather than prescribe a literal historical audit.
The withdrawal and stalled-charge outliers depend on deliberately form-distant branch analogies and must not be presented as lexical glosses.
